description: Review every changed file in one scroll, and ⌘-click any symbol to read its definition without leaving the diff. Press Ctrl+- to step back, so you can follow a call several levels deep and return to the hunk you were reading. Switch between uncommitted changes and all changes since the base branch. Open it with ⌘⇧D or the button in the thread header. Go to definition needs the language server on your PATH: gopls, rust-analyzer, pyright, clangd, or sourcekit-lsp; TypeScript downloads typescript-language-server through npx on first use.
